name: Arms for the Field
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The Ironforge Brigade has been a worthy ally in our fight in Silithus.  Unfortunately, many of their supplies were lost on their way here.  Procure a batch of weapons and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer near Hive'Zora.
narrative.objectives: Bring 2 Moonsteel Broadswords to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost outside of Hive'Zora.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, excellent! I won't have to hear complaints about dull blades anymore. Thank you, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have something for me, adventurer?

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing VI
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing VI
